messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

Here’s a quick rundown of the **long‑weekend holidays** that Canadians will enjoy in 2023.  
(Only the federal holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday create a natural three‑day break; provincial holidays that do the same are noted where relevant.)

| Date | Holiday | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| **Feb 20, 2023 (Mon)** | *Family Day* (Ontario, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island) | Creates a long weekend from Fri 18–Mon 20. |
| **Apr 7, 2023 (Fri)** | *Good Friday* | Natural long weekend (Fri 7–Sun 9). |
| **May 22, 2023 (Mon)** | *Victoria Day* | Long weekend (Fri 19–Mon 22). |
| **Sep 4, 2023 (Mon)** | *Labour Day* | Long weekend (Fri 1–Mon 4). |
| **Oct 9, 2023 (Mon)** | *Thanksgiving* | Long weekend (Fri 6–Mon 9). |
| **Dec 25, 2023 (Mon)** | *Christmas Day* | Long weekend (Fri 22–Mon 25). |

### Other notable holidays that don’t create a long weekend in 2023

| Date | Holiday | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1, 2023 (Sun)** | *New Year’s Day* | Falls on Sunday – no long weekend. |
| **Jul 1, 2023 (Sat)** | *Canada Day* | Falls on Saturday – no long weekend. |
| **Nov 11, 2023 (Wed)** | *Remembrance Day* | Falls on Wednesday – no long weekend. |

> **Pro‑tip:** If you’re planning trips around provincial holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador on Mar 17, 2023), you can still treat them as “mini‑long weekends” if you take the preceding day off.

Feel free to plug these dates straight into your holiday‑planning app!
